## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) — **DCO is required and CI-enforced**
- [ ] `cargo test` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` passes
- [ ] Tests added/updated for the change (bug fixes include a regression test)
- [ ] Documentation under `docs/` updated if behavior changed
- [ ] For non-trivial changes: an issue was opened and discussed first
- [ ] No breaking changes without prior discussion
